children: Ooma Inc reported second-quarter fiscal 2027 results with revenue of $83.2M and diluted EPS of $0.1, reflecting year-over-year revenue growth and improved profitability compared with the year-ago quarter.
Revenue: $83.2M for Q2 FY2027 (three months ended July 31, 2026), up from $66.4M in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 25%.
Net income: $3.00M for Q2 FY2027, versus $1.26M in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 140%.
Diluted EPS: $0.10 for Q2 FY2027, up from $0.04 in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue growth was driven by expansion of Ooma Business and contributions from recent acquisitions, including FluentStream and Phone.com.
Channel and mix shift: Ooma Business represented approximately 70% of revenue (up from 63%), boosting average revenue per core user.
Customer momentum: Core users rose to 1,427, with Business users making up about 49% of the base, supporting higher AERR.
Margins: Subscription gross margin remained steady at 70%; product margins are improving but remain negative.
Acquisitions: Integration of FluentStream and Phone.com materially contributed to revenue and user growth during the quarter.
